name: After § 2
title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2023
part_text: 2g. Believes that the Commission’s own target of 12 months to refer an infringement case to the CJEU if a Member State’s failure to transpose a legislative directive persists should be extended to all other infringement cases with a view to improving the Commission’s overall strategic approach to the enforcement of EU law, thus ensuring an effective and rapid response to violations of EU law in order to safeguard the integrity of EU law, prevent irreversible socio-economic and environmental damage and respond to the pressing need for citizens and businesses to be able to enjoy the benefits arising from the correct and timely application of EU law throughout the Union;
